steps.title: 0. Precondition: private channel exists and Bob is a member (Module C)
2. Alice opens the private channel (Module C)
3-5. Alice attaches a file, enters and sends a message; it is displayed (Modules B + C)
6. Bob (authorized member) logs in and views the message (Modules A + B)
7. Bob searches the message, downloads the file and replies (Modules B + C)
8. Eve (non-member) cannot open, read or find it (Module C / NFR-02)
